description: Defines the ImageItem class for Drupal's image field type plugin, including schema, default settings, sample data generation, and form handling.

classes.name: ImageItem
classes.description: Drupal plugin class for image field type, extending FileItem, managing image-specific schema, settings, and form logic.

methods.name: defaultStorageSettings
methods.description: Returns default storage settings including default image properties and display flag.

methods.name: defaultFieldSettings
methods.description: Returns default field settings such as allowed extensions, alt/title fields, and resolution constraints.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Defines the database schema for image field items, including target_id, alt, title, width, height.

methods.name: propertyDefinitions
methods.description: Defines data properties for image field items, including alt, title, width, height.

methods.name: storageSettingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of storage settings, overridden to avoid redundancy.

methods.name: storageSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds form elements for storage settings, including upload destination options.

methods.name: fieldSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds form for field settings, including resolution constraints, alt/title options, and default image configuration.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Ensures image dimensions are set before saving, logs warning if file missing.

methods.name: generateSampleValue
methods.description: Generates sample image data with random images, sizes, alt text, and titles.

methods.name: validateResolution
methods.description: Validates resolution input fields for width and height.

methods.name: defaultImageForm
methods.description: Builds form section for default image upload and metadata.

methods.name: validateDefaultImageForm
methods.description: Validates and converts default image file ID to UUID.

methods.name: isDisplayed
methods.description: Indicates that image items are always displayed, no per-item visibility.
